{{Quote|The cuisine of the Kubaz may not be for everyone, but I guarantee you'll want to finish your meal with a thick slice of this scrumptious royal jelly roll. The filling is a tasty blend of worker zingbees, arthropinians and pectin-flies, and it's all dusted with powdered sun beetle chitin.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Kubindian royal jelly roll|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Pectin-flies''' were [[Insect/Legends|insects]] eaten by the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] served a [[Kubindian royal jelly roll]] whose filling made with a blend of pectin-flies, [[zingbee]]s and [[arthropinian]]s.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pectin-flies were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
